solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Predict a feeling of annoyance, getting hit hard

parts.note: to bet that something will happen is to predict it
to have the hump is to be sulky and annoyed

explanation.surface: Someone foresees getting irritated after taking a heavy blow.
explanation.walkthrough: The BE- prefix as an intensifier was common in early modern English; Shakespeare's characters bethump each other with words.
explanation.definitionFit: To bethump is an old intensive verb meaning to beat soundly, so it equals striking with force.

clue.text: Muslim female started getting short with male

indicators.note: short means cut off, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: begun is a past participle of begin, started
M is the abbreviation for male

explanation.surface: A Muslim woman began being curt with a man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting short' sounds like becoming curt, but it trims the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A begum is a Muslim woman of high rank in South Asia, or a title for a married Muslim lady.

clue.text: Novel metallic seat having a charming quality

indicators.note: novel means new, so these letters are made into something new

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A newly designed metal seat turns out to be rather appealing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charming' is meant literally: a telesm is a talisman, an object that charms.
explanation.definitionFit: Telesmatical means talismanic, possessing the magical power of a charm or amulet.

clue.text: Pigment of drug-injected meat

indicators.note: something injected is put inside, so the drug letter goes into the meat

parts.note: ham is cured meat from a pig
E is ecstasy, the drug

explanation.surface: Colour comes from meat pumped full of drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Haem is the iron-containing pigment group in haemoglobin that makes blood red.

clue.text: Weight used by Greeks — or Minoans, oddly

indicators.note: oddly points to the letters in odd positions: first, third, fifth and so on

parts.note: letters one, three, five and seven

explanation.surface: A unit of weight once used by Greeks, or perhaps by Cretans of old.
explanation.walkthrough: The Minoans were the Bronze Age people of Crete, which suits the Greek surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A mna, or mina, was an ancient Greek unit of weight and money, equal to a hundred drachmas.

clue.text: Hapless and holy, the husband being ditched needing shelter

indicators.note: needing shelter means it must be housed inside the holy word

parts.note: pious means devout or holy

indicators.note: something ditched is thrown away, so that letter leaves its word

parts.note: taken as written
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A devout woman, abandoned by her husband, is left wretched and seeking a home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hapless and holy' reads as a pair of adjectives, but only the first is the definition; the second is wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Piteous means pitiful or wretched, deserving pity, much as hapless means unlucky and miserable.

clue.text: A distinctive flavour ultimately lacking in jelly

indicators.note: ultimately points to the end of a word, and lacking says that final letter is missing

parts.note: taken as written
spice is a distinctive, piquant flavour

explanation.surface: A cook notes that a jelly is missing some characteristic tang.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspic is a savoury jelly made from meat stock, used to set cold dishes.

clue.text: Stream from a hilltop descending on farm

indicators.note: in a down entry, descending on means sitting above, so the earlier parts come first

parts.note: taken as written
nab is a northern and Scottish word for a hill's summit
a ranch is a large farm

explanation.surface: A brook runs down from the summit onto farmland.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'descending on' puts the first parts above the farm, so they come first.
explanation.definitionFit: An anabranch is a stream that leaves a river and rejoins it further downstream.

clue.text: Workers to be organised in pairs later on

indicators.note: organising things puts them into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Employees will be grouped in twos at some later time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' doubles as a nod to the unions that workers join.
explanation.definitionFit: Proletarians are members of the working class, people who live by selling their labour.

clue.text: Lizards wandering in Nicaragua avoiding vehicle

definitions.note: plural in the clue; the answer is singular in form, or a collective plural

indicators.note: wandering things stray from their path, so the letters move out of order
avoiding something means keeping out of it, so those letters are left out

parts.note: taken as written
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Reptiles roam Nicaragua, staying clear of traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: The iguana is a large tropical American lizard, common in Central America.

clue.text: In one corner of England having little growth is hard

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase for the adjective: belonging to Cornwall

parts.note: a corn is a small hard growth of skin on the foot
taken as written
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Somewhere in England a small crop grows on tough ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Cornwall is the county at England's south-western tip. 'little growth' suggests a crop, but it is a corn on the foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Cornish means of or from Cornwall, the county occupying England's far south-western corner.

clue.text: The French into making money, offering modern form of education

indicators.note: one item going into another means it is placed inside it

parts.note: earning is making money by work
le is the French masculine word for 'the'

explanation.surface: A French teaching outfit cashes in on a new style of education.
explanation.definitionFit: E-learning is education delivered electronically over the internet, a recent development in teaching methods.

clue.text: Old physician with a particular mineral

parts.note: Galen was the celebrated Greek physician of the second century
taken as written

explanation.surface: An ancient doctor is paired with some specific mineral substance.
explanation.definitionFit: Galena is lead sulphide, a specific mineral and the main ore of lead.

clue.text: Song of heretical nationalist being rejected

indicators.note: something rejected is thrown out, so that letter is removed

parts.note: Arian describes the heresy of Arius, who denied Christ's full divinity
N is the abbreviation for nationalist

explanation.surface: A heretic's patriotic anthem is turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a song for solo voice, especially in an opera.

clue.text: Trip in which sailor is given drum

indicators.note: in which says the following item sits within the trip

parts.note: a tour is a trip or journey
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: On a voyage, a seaman is handed a drum to play.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabour is a small drum, traditionally played with one hand while the other plays a pipe.

clue.text: Acts as tutor to member of aristocracy wearing hippy accessories?

indicators.note: something worn goes around the wearer, so the noble sits inside

parts.note: strings of beads were a hippy accessory
an earl is a nobleman

explanation.surface: A tutor to a young lord turns up wearing love beads.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags hippy accessories as an example of beads.
explanation.definitionFit: A bear-leader was a tutor escorting a rich young man on travels, so to bear-lead is to act as such.

clue.text: Dish of beef king cast aside

indicators.note: casting something aside means getting rid of it, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: flank is a cut of beef from the animal's side
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch rejects a plate of beef put before him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of beef' reads as describing the dish, but it stands for a cut of beef from which the K is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A flan is an open pastry case with a filling, served as a dish.

clue.text: Something dim about agent getting nothing right in inaccurate account

indicators.note: about means going around, so the first word wraps around what follows

parts.note: mist makes everything dim and hazy
a rep, or representative, is an agent
nothing is zero, shaped like O
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A shady agent comes up with nothing correct in a false report.
explanation.walkthrough: The container holds three pieces at once: agent, nothing and right all sit inside the dim thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A misreport is an incorrect account of events, a report that gets things wrong.

clue.text: Artist wants food and drink — a bit of a nerve is that?

definitions.text: a bit of a nerve is that?
definitions.note: the answer is an adjective; the clue asks whether a branch of a nerve is rameal

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the stock artist
a meal is food and drink taken together

explanation.surface: A painter demands lunch, then asks if that takes some cheek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A bit of a nerve' looks like cheek, but it means a branch of a nerve; rameal describes such branches.
explanation.definitionFit: Rameal means relating to a branch, a ramus; a nerve's branch is a ramus, hence rameal.

clue.text: Sort of number — manage it to secure record

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast inside, so the record goes within

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
an EP, extended play, is a record
taken as written

explanation.surface: A kind of figure is needed to run a business that is putting out a disc.
explanation.definitionFit: A repunit is a number made only of repeated ones, such as 11 or 111.

clue.text: Candid written accusation artist penned

indicators.note: penned means shut in a pen, so the artist is enclosed

parts.note: libel is a false accusation in writing
RA, Royal Academician, is the stock artist

explanation.surface: A painter writes a frank, damning charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penned' looks like written, but it means enclosed.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberal can mean free and frank, outspoken in speech, an older sense close to candid.

clue.text: Greek characters participating in street assembly

indicators.note: participating in means taking part in, so the answer is a part of the following words

parts.note: found running across the end of the first word into the start of the second

explanation.surface: People of Greek origin join a gathering in the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet, so etas are Greek characters.

clue.text: Royal's no leader — equivalent to a famous writer

indicators.note: having no leader means the front letter is taken away

parts.note: regal means royal

explanation.surface: A royal without precedence ranks only equal with a great author.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'has'. The famous writer is Shakespeare, who used egal for equal; the definition is the word in his vocabulary.
explanation.definitionFit: Egal is an obsolete, Shakespearean form meaning equal, which is what equivalent means.

clue.text: Concrete holiday home occupied by a Parisian

indicators.note: a place occupied by someone has them inside it

parts.note: a gîte is a French holiday cottage
un is French for a

explanation.surface: A solid holiday cottage is taken over by someone from Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Concrete' looks like an adjective, solid; it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Gunite is a concrete mix sprayed through a hose, used for lining pools and tunnels.

clue.text: Handle cattle in shed, half having escaped

indicators.note: half of a word escaping means only one half of its letters stays
in says the livestock word is placed inside the other

parts.note: half of the word shed
neat is an old word for cattle

explanation.surface: Someone manages the cows in a barn after half have got out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handle' looks like a verb about managing cattle; it is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A sneath, more often spelt snath, is the long handle of a scythe.

clue.text: Sheep's offspring brought up on grass primarily

indicators.note: brought up in a down entry means raised from bottom to top, read in reverse

parts.note: get is an old word for offspring, especially of an animal

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter counts

parts.note: first letter of grass

explanation.surface: A lamb raised mainly on grazing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tegg, or teg, is a sheep in its second year, before its first shearing.

clue.text: Strange car boot sale disposing of old books — and fish!

indicators.note: strange suggests something out of its normal order, so the letters get rearranged
disposing of things means getting rid of them, so these letters are taken out

parts.note: taken as written
OT, Old Testament, is the old books of the Bible

explanation.surface: An odd jumble sale gets rid of its old books, and some fish too.
explanation.walkthrough: A car boot sale is a British market where people sell junk from their car boots (trunks). Remove one O and one T, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Albacores are tunas, large ocean fish prized for their pale meat.

clue.text: Garden clippers not right for trees

indicators.note: not means without, so the right letter is left out of the clippers

parts.note: shears are large garden clippers
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Hedge clippers that are wrong for pruning trees.
explanation.definitionFit: The shea is an African tree whose nuts yield shea butter.

clue.text: Operating system that's "superior" leading to nothing

parts.note: U means upper class or superior, as in U and non-U
nix is slang for nothing

explanation.surface: A self-styled superior computer system comes to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Unix is a well-known multi-user computer operating system developed at Bell Labs.

clue.text: Fellow on island offers facility for prayer

parts.note: a man is a fellow
I is the abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A man on an island provides somewhere to pray.
explanation.definitionFit: In Tibetan Buddhism a mani is a prayer wheel or a stone carved with prayers, an aid to worship.

clue.text: Reserved and haughty female being put off potato

indicators.note: putting something off removes it, so that letter goes

parts.note: aloof means distant and standoffish
F is the abbreviation for female

explanation.surface: A cool, proud woman is turned off by a potato.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloo is the Hindi word for potato, familiar from Indian dishes such as aloo gobi.

clue.text: In rack, loose seed

indicators.note: letters set loose are freed from their order and can be rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Seed spills loose from a storage rack.
explanation.definitionFit: A nickar is the hard, grey seed of a tropical climbing shrub, used as a marble.

clue.text: First sign of organ 11 reconstructed

indicators.note: something reconstructed is put together again differently, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 11 across

explanation.surface: An organ's first trace is rebuilt from another entry.
explanation.definitionFit: In embryology an anlage is the primordium, the earliest rudiment from which an organ develops.

clue.text: Nursemaid hides male offspring in trees

indicators.note: to hide something is to keep it inside, so the nurse word goes around what follows

parts.note: aia, a variant of ayah, is an Indian nursemaid
Dan is an old title for a man, like master or sir
a son is male offspring

explanation.surface: A nanny conceals a boy up in the trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Male offspring' looks like one idea but gives two pieces; Dan is an archaic title for a man, like sir.
explanation.definitionFit: Adansonia is the botanical genus of the baobab trees of Africa and Australia.

clue.text: Place to stay, no small house with huge aim

indicators.note: no says the house abbreviation is missing from the place word

parts.note: a hotel is a place to stay
HO is the short form of house
OS, outsize, means huge

explanation.surface: A lodging with no cottage but a grand purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Telos is the Greek word for an end or ultimate purpose, used in philosophy for a goal.

clue.text: Big car has little girl with huge appetite

parts.note: a limo, or limousine, is a big luxury car
sis is short for sister, a little girl

explanation.surface: A limousine carries a small girl who eats enormously.
explanation.definitionFit: Limosis is a medical term for abnormal hunger, an excessive craving for food.
